about.en: XTEN is the native token of Extended, the USDC-settled perpetuals exchange formerly called X10. The token has not been distributed yet: Extended has announced an initial supply of 1 billion XTEN, with 30% reserved for participants in its Extended Points programme, and a launch in November 2026, with the full token economics and a MiCA white paper to be published beforehand. Until then XTEN trades only as pre-market contracts and pre-market perpetuals on other venues.
